name: UP Scholarship
summary: Online scholarship and fee reimbursement services for eligible students in Uttar Pradesh.
likely_eligibility: The applicant should be studying in an eligible institution and course.
Income, category, domicile and academic conditions depend on the current scheme rules.
Final eligibility is decided by the competent department.
steps: Open the official scholarship portal.
Read the current notification and eligibility rules.
Register or log in and fill the application carefully.
Upload or submit the requested documents.
Save the application number and track the status.

name: Income Certificate
summary: A certificate issued by the competent authority to record a family's or applicant's income for eligible official purposes.
likely_eligibility: The applicant should satisfy the residence and documentation requirements of the issuing authority.
The final document list and process can vary by district and service channel.
common_documents: Other documents requested by the authority
steps: Open the official e-District or citizen-service portal.
Choose the income certificate service.
Complete the form and attach the required documents.
Pay the applicable service fee, if shown by the portal.
Keep the application receipt for status tracking.

name: Caste Certificate
summary: A certificate issued by the competent authority for eligible applicants belonging to a recognised category.
likely_eligibility: The applicant must meet the applicable category and residence requirements.
The competent authority verifies the submitted records before issuance.
steps: Visit the official e-District or citizen-service portal.
Select the relevant caste certificate service.
Fill in the application with correct information.
Submit the required supporting documents.
Track the application using the receipt or application number.

name: Old Age Pension
summary: Social pension guidance for senior citizens who meet the applicable age, income, residence and other rules.
likely_eligibility: Age, income and residence conditions apply.
The applicant must satisfy the latest rules shown by the social-welfare department.
Approval is subject to verification by the department.
steps: Open the official social pension portal.
Review the current eligibility rules.
Complete the online application or visit an authorised service centre.
Submit the requested documents.
Save the registration details and check application status.

name: PM-KISAN
summary: A central government farmer-support service for beneficiaries who satisfy the current official eligibility and verification rules.
likely_eligibility: The applicant must satisfy the current official beneficiary conditions.
Identity, land and bank information may be verified by the responsible authorities.
steps: Open the official PM-KISAN portal.
Read the current eligibility and exclusion conditions.
Use the relevant farmer registration or status service.
Provide accurate details and complete required verification.
Check status only through the official portal or authorised channel.
